title: descriptors
description: Hub to phone, after `welcome` when both sides have the `descriptors` capability, and again whenever a hub Bucket comes, goes or changes. Each one is a full snapshot: it replaces every Descriptor the hub sent before. The phone caches the latest snapshot.

buckets.description: Every Bucket the hub's Providers publish, one Descriptor each. Ids are unique within a snapshot.

descriptor.description: One Bucket, described for the phone. The phone never runs Provider code; it runs the Primitives named here.

id.description: Stable across connections and hub restarts; the key the phone caches the Bucket under and addresses it by.

name.description: What the loop says for the Bucket. It always counts as an alias.

aliases.description: Further phrases that name the Bucket.

type.description: The kind of Bucket. Known in v1.0: `agent`, `hub`. A phone treats a type it does not know like any other Bucket, by its Primitives.

primitives.description: The Primitives this Bucket uses. Known in v1.0: `note`, `draft`, `speak_item`, `request`. A phone that does not know one of them keeps only the Bucket's `request` commands, and the loop says so once.

commands.description: The phrases that are commands while the Bucket has Focus, in a deterministic grammar.

id.description: Unique within the Descriptor; what the phone sends back to name the command.

phrases.description: What the person says. The first is the canonical phrase.

primitive.description: The Primitive that runs the command, one of the Descriptor's `primitives`.
